headline: Concordia Irvine play on as the conference's last side
dek: Concordia Irvine beat Cal State LA to reach 41 goals in all matches, more than any of the other nine programmes, and are the only side in the conference with a match still to play. Their two defeats both came against Point Loma, who finished the table unbeaten.
displaced_by: Concordia Irvine's 41 goals pass Point Loma's 40, so the standing dek's 'more than any' claim is false; Concordia are the last side still playing
